content:
User test (playtest done with an AI agent for TidyMaze):
Tested: 6 demo games (levels 2 and 3, 3 games each) with a bot that makes every unit charge the nearest enemy unit at power 100. The arena rank was not read.
Bugs: none found. In these 6 games there was no invalid output, no timeout and no error line.
Unclear rules:
- The three level statements are identical, and the Leagues section names the First, Second and top league without saying which level is which. A player cannot tell from the statement what changes between levels.
- The Expert Rules set W.planted to true on PLANT, but nothing resets it to false. The text says PLANT lasts "That turn", so the pseudo-code should reset it every turn.
Observation: in these 6 games the side that ended with 0 units lost; the other side kept 6 units in 5 games and 4 units in 1 game. The units of the losing side were knocked out between turns 27 and 199.
Suggestion: state which level is which league, and reset the planted flag in the pseudo-code.
What works well: the Expert Rules and the stamina examples are detailed enough to check by hand.

Expert rules
* Final paragraph: Please format "x" and "y" using the <var> tag.

Output for one game turn
* Please reformat "x y power" as <var>x</var> <var>y</var> <var>power</var>.

Thanks.
A+, will try soon, looks fun!

Center camping seems to be the key with the current rules. Also most of the action seems to start when the circle shrinks. I'm wondering if a hole in the center could be interesting. Or maybe a "push" magnet in the center. Or instead of a shrinking circle make it a moving circle so the blobs have to keep moving inside, creating movement and fighting. Or mabye shrink from turn 1 but pause the shrinking for 10 turns every 10 turns or something like that. Maybe there could be resources spawnning here and there giving a stamina boost over time or something worth picking up. Maybe we could increase colision force or decrease friction as well. A pack of 6 blobs together is pretty resistant.
